package ${package};

import com.codename1.cli.CommandLine;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

/**
 * Runs the tool's command line in process. CliApplication is generated by the
 * build from the @Command classes, so it is there before the tests compile.
 */
class HelloTest {
    @Test
    void greets() {
        assertEquals(0, CommandLine.run("__PROJECT_NAME__", CliApplication.commands(),
                new String[] {"--count", "2", "Ada"}));
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsAnUnknownOption() {
        assertEquals(CommandLine.USAGE_ERROR, CommandLine.run("__PROJECT_NAME__",
                CliApplication.commands(), new String[] {"--nope", "Ada"}));
    }
}
